## What kind of contribution is this?

Check the one that applies

- [ ] Blog post  
- [ ] Resource addition  
- [ ] Presentation materials  
- [ ] Site improvement

---

## What does this contribution add or change?

A sentence or two is fine. Tell us what you're sharing and why it might be useful to the BRUG community  
---

## Checklist

Not every item applies to every contribution. Check what's relevant and leave the rest — don't let an unchecked box stop you from submitting

- [ ] I've included a YAML header with title, author, and date (blog posts)  
- [ ] My code examples run on a clean R session (blog posts with code)  
- [ ] I've added a brief annotation explaining why this resource is useful (resource additions)  
- [ ] I've included an index.qmd with title, presenter, and date (presentations)
